notes: Competing reading for t017-t018: marking *for it* added under rule 44's supplied-object clause; taken the other way because the bare *suffer* does not carry נֶעֱנָשׁוּ's sense and the phrase is one rendering rather than a supplied object beside a complete one. The ASV italicizes its three connectives here but not *for it*, which corroborates without deciding (rule 7).
All three of the ASV's connectives here are italic and answer to no waw; the count of conjunctions against connectives (rule 42's method) leaves the English side in surplus three times.
